review_description: Timing of contact and quote was outstanding and content comprehensive.The 2 installers worked well together and were very nice guys.It is over a month since completion and believe we still have no grid connection.

Crawfords gave us a very competitive price based on LFP batteries and a diesel generator suited to our off-grid situation (not a "gold-plated" set-up quoted by a competitor), and gave us a 50% higher trade-in on our old batteries.They were prompt, efficient, very friendly, and their follow-up service is excellent.  We highly recommend them.
